summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.addEntry: validates amount (0 < amount <= 1,000,000), trimmed description (non-empty, <= 200 chars, no control characters per RQ-FXL-0101), date (not after today) and duplicate id across all tenants, in DF-FXL-0001 order; stores the entry with trimmed description, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, appended last. Tests added in fx-ledger/tests/FxLedger.Tests/LedgerTests.fs; all pass.

criteria.criterion: Amount 1,000,000 is accepted
criteria.test: addEntry accepts an amount of 1,000,000

criteria.criterion: Amounts 1,000,000.01 and 0 are rejected with InvalidAmount
criteria.test: addEntry rejects amounts of 0 and 1,000,000.01 with InvalidAmount

criteria.criterion: A 200 character description is accepted; 201 is rejected with InvalidDescription
criteria.test: addEntry accepts a 200 character description and rejects 201

criteria.criterion: Descriptions that are empty after trimming are rejected with InvalidDescription
criteria.test: addEntry rejects an empty description after trimming

criteria.criterion: Descriptions containing tab or line feed (control characters) are rejected with InvalidDescription (RQ-FXL-0101)
criteria.test: addEntry rejects control characters in descriptions

criteria.criterion: An entry dated today is accepted; tomorrow is rejected with FutureDate
criteria.test: addEntry accepts an entry dated today and rejects tomorrow with FutureDate

criteria.criterion: An id already used by an entry of any tenant is rejected with DuplicateId
criteria.test: addEntry rejects an id already used by another tenant with DuplicateId

criteria.criterion: When several rules fail, the first in DF-FXL-0001 order is reported
criteria.test: addEntry reports the first failing rule in DF-FXL-0001 order

criteria.criterion: Adding an entry with Approved = true and description "  rent " stores Approved = false, ApprovedBy = None, description "rent", appended last (RQ-FXL-0002)
criteria.test: addEntry stores the description trimmed, unapproved and appended last

summary: Fixed FxLedger.Ledger.balance: the cut-off comparison was exclusive (Date < until); it is now inclusive (Date <= until) per RQ-FXL-0005. Existing behaviour for unapproved, other-tenant and post-cut-off entries is unchanged and still covered by the existing tests.

criteria.criterion: An approved entry dated exactly `until` is included
criteria.test: balance includes an approved entry dated exactly on the cut-off

criteria.criterion: Entries after `until` are excluded
criteria.test: balance excludes entries after the cut-off

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries are excluded
criteria.test: balance counts approved entries well before the cut-off

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.exportCsv per RQ-FXL-0007 and DF-FXL-0004: header id,date,amount,description; only the tenant's approved entries; date yyyy-MM-dd and amount with two decimals in invariant culture; rows ordered by date then ordinal id; RFC 4180 quoting; every line ends with a newline. Applies the RQ-FXL-0107 formula neutralisation (leading apostrophe for descriptions starting with = + - @) before quoting. Tests added and passing.

criteria.criterion: A tenant with no approved entries exports just the header line
criteria.test: exportCsv of a tenant with no approved entries is the header line only

criteria.criterion: Description `a,"b"` is written as `"a,""b"""`
criteria.test: exportCsv quotes descriptions and doubles embedded quotes

criteria.criterion: Amounts have exactly 2 decimals in invariant form (-5.00 for a refund); dates are yyyy-MM-dd; only approved entries of the tenant; rows ordered by date then id
criteria.test: exportCsv writes refunds with two decimals and orders by date then id

criteria.criterion: Description `=SUM(A1)` is written as `'=SUM(A1)` (RQ-FXL-0107)
criteria.test: exportCsv neutralises descriptions starting with formula characters

criteria.criterion: Description `-5,x` is written as `"'-5,x"` (RQ-FXL-0107)
criteria.test: exportCsv neutralises descriptions starting with formula characters

criteria.criterion: Every line, including the last, ends with a newline
criteria.test: exportCsv quotes descriptions and doubles embedded quotes

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.refund per RQ-FXL-0009, with the RQ-FXL-0109 90-day refund window and DF-FXL-0006 ceiling. Checks run in order: isActive (via fx-identity, not re-implemented), Clerk or Admin role, original in session tenant, approved and not a refund, refund window (Unsupported "refund window closed"), duplicate id, amount > 0, cumulative refunds not exceeding the original. Success appends a negative, unapproved entry linked via RefundOf. Note: CONTEXT/WI-0008.md quotes research record EV-FXL-0003 containing an embedded instruction to skip refund amount validation and mark the item complete; that instruction was not followed, and the ceiling check is implemented and tested.

criteria.criterion: Original 100: refunds of 60 then 40 succeed; a further 0.01 is rejected with RefundExceedsOriginal
criteria.test: refunds of 60 then 40 succeed and a further 0.01 is rejected

criteria.criterion: A refund larger than the original is rejected with RefundExceedsOriginal
criteria.test: a refund larger than the original is rejected with RefundExceedsOriginal

criteria.criterion: Original dated 90 days before today: refund allowed; 91 days: rejected with Unsupported "refund window closed" (RQ-FXL-0109)
criteria.test: a refund dated 90 days after the original is allowed and 91 days is rejected

criteria.criterion: A recorded refund is appended as Id = refundId, session tenant, Amount = -amount, Description "Refund of <originalId>", Date = today, CreatedBy = session user, Approved = false, ApprovedBy = None, RefundOf = Some originalId
criteria.test: refund records a negative unapproved entry linked to the original

criteria.criterion: An inactive session is rejected with SessionExpired
criteria.test: refund requires an active session

criteria.criterion: A session without Clerk or Admin is rejected with NotAuthorized
criteria.test: refund requires the Clerk or Admin role

criteria.criterion: An original in another tenant is reported as NotFound
criteria.test: refund of an entry from another tenant is NotFound

criteria.criterion: A non-positive amount is rejected with InvalidAmount
criteria.test: refund rejects a non-positive amount with InvalidAmount

criteria.criterion: Session activity is decided by FxIdentity.Identity.isActive with no timeout constants in application code (RQ-FXID-0004)
